pdf.title: Corrections and resource bounds for the Trotter quantum transport algorithm

visual_qa.method: All 25 pages of the initial 120-dpi Poppler raster were visually inspected in labelled contact sheets. All 25 pages of the repaired PDF were rendered anew; exact PNG hash comparison found pages 1-14 identical, inheriting those completed visual checks. Repaired pages 15-25 were each freshly inspected in new labelled contact sheets.

resolved_issue.description: The initial PDF rendered backslashes in place of spaces in the two inline Python reproduction commands. The parent repaired the build conversion; both commands now display and extract with the intended spaces.

nonblocking_layout_observations.description: A single-word continuation, state., starts the page; the paragraph is complete and readable.
A bold source-equation introduction at the end of page 20 precedes its display on page 21; the equation and associated text are complete.

visual_qa.render_evidence: Poppler page PNGs, contact sheets and render-record.json retained in the requested local qa-1.1.1 workspace, including rebuilt-5018/; these are local QA evidence, not publication artifacts.
